featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 Stars for the Food
1 Star for the Pricing

I generally try not to give low ratings to businesses and prefer to give them the benefit of the doubt whenever possible.

However, fairness in reviewing also means pointing out issues when they arise.

Amar Juice Centre has long been a popular spot opposite Girgaon Chowpatty for quick snacks and street-style dishes. I’ve visited here multiple times over the years and have generally enjoyed the food.

On this visit, I ordered the Dahi Puri, which as always was excellent. The flavours were well balanced, the puris were crisp, and the overall taste was exactly what one expects from a good Mumbai chaat spot. In terms of quality, taste, and preparation, the food easily deserves five stars.

However, the pricing is where the experience becomes difficult to justify. The last time I visited, around 2024, the Dahi Puri was roughly ₹90. On this visit it was priced around ₹180 before taxes. That represents nearly a 100% increase in a relatively short period of time.

While some increase due to inflation is understandable, such a steep jump in pricing over roughly a year or two feels excessive from the perspective of a regular customer. Inflation sits generally at 5% a year not 50% a year!!

So while the food and service remain very good, and pretty much exactly as it was 2 years ago, the pricing makes the overall value difficult to justify.

Food & Service: ★★★★★
Pricing / Value: ★☆☆☆☆

Overall rating: ★★☆☆☆

Since it was our first time, we asked the staff which one was the best, and they suggested the Seetha Phal (custard apple) cream pudding, so we ordered that along with rose milk falooda.

featured_reviews.name: Sakib Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
A perennial favorite among locals and tourists alike, Haji Ali Juice Centre is an iconic culinary landmark nestled at the threshold of the historic Haji Ali Dargah. Since its inception in the 1960s, this bustling establishment has cultivated a legendary status, evolving from a modest stop for pilgrims into a vibrant gastronomic institution. It is celebrated for its unwavering commitment to quality, utilizing fresh, seasonal ingredients to craft an extensive repertoire of refreshments that have become synonymous with Mumbai's street food culture.
Reviewers frequently highlight the establishment's ability to maintain high standards of hygiene and flavor despite the immense daily crowds. The atmosphere is quintessentially Mumbai—a high-energy, casual setting where patrons often enjoy their treats standing on the pavement or from the comfort of their cars, adding a unique drive-in charm to the experience.
• Signature Fruit Creams: The "Sitaphal" (custard apple) cream is universally acclaimed as a must-try masterpiece, featuring a luscious, thick consistency generously laden with fresh fruit chunks.
• Exotic Shakes & Juices: Guests often praise the Mango Milkshake for its rich, creamy texture and the "Triveni"—a sophisticated blend of mango, strawberry, and kiwi juices.
• Savoury Accompaniments: Beyond beverages, the menu boasts popular fusion snacks like the Jain Pizza and the indulgent Cheese Toast, noted for its generous cheese-to-bread ratio.
• Late-Night Accessibility: Operating from the early morning until well past midnight, it serves as a reliable sanctuary for night revelers seeking high-quality refreshments.

featured_reviews.name: Sanoop ks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Haji Ali Juice Centre is one of those places in Mumbai that almost everyone has heard about, and naturally, expectations are quite high before visiting. The menu is extensive, filled with a wide variety of juices, shakes, and desserts that look appealing at first glance. The taste of the items is definitely good—fresh, flavorful, and satisfying to an extent. You can tell that the ingredients are of decent quality and prepared well.

However, beyond that initial impression, nothing truly stands out. There isn’t anything particularly unique or memorable about the flavors that would make you want to come back again and again. It feels like what you get is something you could easily find at many other juice shops across the city.

One of the biggest drawbacks is how overhyped the place feels. Because of its popularity and constant crowd, you go in expecting something exceptional, but the experience turns out to be fairly average. This mismatch between expectation and reality is quite noticeable.

On top of that, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side for what is offered. While the quality is decent, it doesn’t quite justify the cost, making it seem overrated.

Overall, Haji Ali Juice Centre delivers good taste but nothing extraordinary. It’s worth trying once for the experience, but it may not live up to the hype surrounding it.

featured_reviews.name: saumil shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Apsara icecream is a renowned icecream parlour  brand of Mumbai since around 50 yrs. I believe as of today they have about 30 outlets in Mumbai itself.They also have outlets spread across other cities of India.I visited their Malabar hill outlet  yesterday night which is their iconic outlet

They serve variety of icecreams in cups(small,medium.large)  as well as cones.

Icecreams made here are with natural flavours and not artificial flavours.These icecreams are handchurned icecreams.

Staff service is reasonably good at Malabar hill outlet but i personally have seen better staff service at other parlours.Definite scope of improvement on staff service front.Apart from icecreams they also have sorbets & shakes.

Coming to variety of icecreams i tried here

Guava glory (small cup)- Star icecream of Apsara for me .Try it with red chilli powder(peru chaat masala) on top of icecream .Highly recommended

Malai kulfi stick -This about taking you back to sweet childhood memories.

Its a delicious sweet dessert served on stick .You will relish it if you like malai flavour.They also have options in pistachio and kesar pista.

Beligan bites (cone) -This i tried in waffle cone.This is all about enjoying Beligan chocolate with chips

Scrumptious sitafal(small cup) -A perfect combination of icecream and exotic creamy fruit.This is dessert goodness at next level.I personally loved it

Pan pasand(cone) - Before visiting this place.I had heard a lot of good things about their pan pasand icecream.Try this and you will thank me for recommending it

Tamarind twist(sorbet) - Imli in form of dessert.This is innovation and experimentation at its best.This sorbet has sharp flavour of tangy tamarind.

My overall experience was reasonably good at Apsara icecreams.A good option for late night icecream cravings.

I genuinely hope to see them coming up with premium range of desserts in coming times.

I didnt try their Thandai and couple of other shakes.Will definitely try it the next time i visit them

Overall - Definitely worth your  money

Check it out

Saumil shah

featured_reviews.name: Bhumi Bhangre
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is about my juice experience at the kemps corner location on December 21, 2024. I had an appointment for my gel nails extension with gel polish and toe gel polish. After I was assigned an artist she recommended that I have to do manicure pedicure before my gel polishes as there was a lot of dead skin buildup. I had no plans of doing that as I was short on time but she said it will only take 10 mins to do, which seemed fishy as I don’t know what kind of manicure pedicure is done in 10 mins but I agreed as she said that the gel polish will not look nice if we don’t remove the dead skin which can only happen with manicure. But as they were doing my manicure, turns out that their water heater was not functioning and my mani pedi was done with room temperature water. I have never seen cuticles softening or skin becoming softer with just room temperature water. Normal mani pedi has steps of cleansing, scrubbing, massage, moisturizer application, cleaning, filing of nails but the whole process here was different.
The nail artist only dipped my hands in room temperature water, filed my hand nails and removed dead skin. Even with the feet, i was assigned some random guy who dipped my feet in water, cut and filed my nails and as I complained later came to apply cream and massaged it for barely a minute. I have never experienced this bad of a mani pedi session. Not at all relaxing. Do not recommend. But I was charged full price for this less than half hearted service.

Coming on my gel nail extensions, I was constantly telling the artist that the shape is uneven, not all lengths are the same, there are big bumps on my nails, the extensions are so fat and thick, the nail hasn’t been stuck properly as it sticks to my skin and now is hurting while doing any activity. Even the polish application is so bad that there are some bald patches at places. I dis a basic French tip, but even the tip is left uneven from the edges, doesn’t go all the way to the edge of the nail.
When I kept complaining, the artist kept on saying one thing that my bail bed is smaller and not the same on both hands and hence the problem, but I have never had a problem earlier when i’ve done it from other places. It was always been smooth and even. My feet polish was being done by not a nail artists but the guy who gives massages, and the polish he put was so horrible. Had I not complained 3-4 times about how horribly he was putting my polish they would have let him only do my feet gel polish which were also french tips. Cannot imagine that something like doing french tips was being assigned to not a nail artists but the guy who gives foot massages.

Overall, a horrible experience! I understand that during the wedding season it may get busy but do not take appointments that you cannot. In my case I was asked too much to do mani pedi even when they did not have facilities to do that. Plus the nail artists are horrible and not experienced at all. DO NOT RECOMMEND!!

I had a really disappointing experience here and honestly didn’t expect this level of service.

I ordered a strawberry matcha with almond milk and made sure to clearly repeat my order twice to the staff taking it. Despite that, what I received was nowhere close to what I asked for, it was literally like a strawberry milkshake. That’s not a small mistake; it completely changes the drink.

When it came to the matcha itself, it was even worse. The taste was completely off and felt very poorly put together. Instead of using something like real strawberry jam or compote, they seemed to have just added some artificial strawberry essence. It tasted synthetic and unpleasant, which completely ruined the matcha experience.

This isn’t just about taste. it’s about basic attention to orders and quality control. When you’re charging premium prices for specialty beverages, the least you can do is get the order right and maintain some standard in preparation.

Really disappointing overall. Definitely not the kind of experience you expect when ordering something as simple as a matcha.

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted to visit some good places where I can try a variety of juice and shakes so I visited the craufet market, so I tried searching for some famous stalls or places for food/juice for which I got to know that "Pappu Juice wala" is pretty famous on Mohammad Ali Road. I saw the pictures and decided to visit.

So the stall is at the main road itself, you will easily locate it via Google map. So they provide juice and shakes according to season, currently strawberry is the main fruit. The cost of juice/shakes is very economical you can try it in the range of Rs50-Rs200 all the juices.

They use fresh fruits and everything, they cut the fruits right in front of you. The only thing I did not like was the hygiene. So just next to the stall they have a dustbin where you can throw you cutleries and everything and they throw the residue of the fruits. So, this dustbin attracts lots of flies and other insects. At the same time due to too many crowds they keep cutting the fruit continuously for the juice and shakes but they do not cover it with anything, so the fruit pieces are open and the shop is on the road and they have a dustbin as well next to the stall. So I will definitely recommend them to change this.

Talking about the shakes you shall definitely try the strawberry 🍓 cream shake, they use fresh strawberry and cream it is recommended.
Whereas you can also try coconut cream shake, they serve it in the coconut shell. I am not much of a fan of 🥥 coconut thus I did not like it, but my friends love it. so you shall definitely try that too. It's an all season thing.

Rest I am sharing the photos which you can see and judge accordingly.

A very popular fruit juice corner. Their most unique serving is the cream of fruit juices like watermelon cream, coconut cream, mango cream etc.

And then they spread amul fresh cream all over it , further garnishing it with dry fruits.
The dish thus prepared is so unique that one might not have tasted it for sure ever. It also is so damn tasty that it will surely make you give another visit.
